<script>
  /* NAMED (Nov 25 2026, LR-4): the boombox's scale on a phone: the room the page has (its width less 24 px of padding) over the
     box's 440 px, at most 1. Only the phone rule above reads it, so the desktop window is unchanged. */
  (function () {
    function fit() {
      var w = Math.min(window.innerWidth, document.documentElement.clientWidth || window.innerWidth);
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--bbx-pop-fit", String(Math.min(1, Math.floor(((w - 24) / 440) * 1000) / 1000)));
    }
    fit();
    window.addEventListener("resize", fit);
  })();
</script>
